principle: A developer-run pipeline that scrapes GitHub + (governed) Facebook for new AI tools/repos and CONSUMES them into ideas -> candidate tools / plugins / capabilities for our registries. Keys come from the runtime KEY HOLDER (BYO: a developer sets the env var -> their account/plan; or platform-within-limits). Everything stays a CANDIDATE: license-classified, deduped vs our registries, candidate-only feed + proposals — NOT auto-added (promotion boundary; discovery≠trust). Social sources are PUBLIC-only, no-PII, ToS-honoring, honest-unavailable without a held key. serves_truth=false.

sources.note: keyless works; OH_GITHUB_TOKEN (held) lifts the rate

sources.governance: PUBLIC page metadata only, no PII, honor Meta ToS; needs a held RAPIDAPI_KEY else honest-unavailable
sources.note: FB public pages/groups SHARE AI tools -> extract links -> resolve GitHub repos
the governed browser ladder when an API path is blocked

stages.do: query each reachable source (key holder gates social); collect hits with provenance
stages.honest: a source with no held key -> honest 'needs <ENV_VAR>', never fabricated

stages.do: license-classify (single source) + map each hit to the tool-plane/capability it serves
turn each into idea kinds: TOOL (a tool_registry candidate for a plane) / PLUGIN (an integration/add-on) / CAPABILITY (could seed a new ladder, esp. a thin plane)
dedupe vs our registries; permissive -> vendorable, copyleft/unstated -> technique-only; write candidate feed + proposals; NOTHING auto-promoted
